verdict.rationale: The evidence shows list endpoints with filters (by domain, meeting type, team) and SDK pagination. These are read-and-filter building blocks, not a documented bulk-operation capability. Nothing documents batch endpoints, multi-select actions, or applying a single operation across many meetings at once. Per-item endpoints such as get summary or transcript by recording ID point to item-by-item access only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
